text:
raj: Heads-up — planning to enable synaptic-13b in the model catalog tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Need a quick decision on fallback ordering and whether we pin a variant. @olivia @matt can you weigh in?

olivia: Staggered rollout + region scoping pls. Can we start US-only at 5%? EU had tail latency issues last week.

deploybot: Deploybot preflight: FAILED → catalog.fallback_order conflicts with existing pinlist for model family 'synaptic'. See /preflight/1767774321 for details.

leah: Oncall note — harbor-13b-v2 had a p95 spike on Tuesday for EU. If synaptic becomes higher priority there it could amplify. Recommend keeping harbor as higher priority for EU during initial rollout.

matt: I propose variant pin instead of global reorder: create synaptic:variant-b with lower priority than harbor in EU, higher in US. Keeps existing EU fallback. Quick config snippet:```yaml
catalog_entry:
  model: synaptic-13b
  variant: b
  priority_by_region:
    us: 10
    eu: 5
```

raj: That sounds good. Proposed rollout phases: phase1 — US-only 5% (08:00–09:00 UTC), phase2 — US+APAC 20% (10:00–12:00 UTC), phase3 — global ramp to 100% over 24h. Rollback triggers: p95 latency +10ms vs baseline OR error rate >0.5%.

jia: Product copy request — need a one-liner for release notes and an API alias mention (model_alias = "s13b-latest"). Also, mention the pinning behavior so integrators know fallback rules.

leah: Agree to the phases. Add a deploybot pin hold for 2h after phase2 (manual lift) so SRE can validate telemetry.

alex: I'll run routing sanity before phase1: `curl -sS https://canary.api.redwood/v1/health?model=synaptic-13b | jq .route` — will post results 07:40 UTC.

deploybot: Re-running preflight with proposed config... PASS. Suggested command: `/deploy catalog enable --model synaptic-13b --variant b --phase phase1 --window 08:00-12:00UTC --pin-hold 2h`

raj: Thanks. @ops-oncall please monitor p95 and tail error-rate during the window. I'll post the short rollout note to #release-notes and to the external changelog.

ops-oncall: I'll be on standby 07:30–13:00 UTC. Set alerts: p95 > 120ms, error_rate > 0.4%. I'll mute noisy infra alerts and escalate to SRE if thresholds breach.

jia: Draft release blurb: "Enable synaptic-13b (initial canary). US-only 5% to start; variant B pinned lower priority in EU to preserve existing harbor-13b fallback. Integrators: use alias `s13b-latest`. Rollback criteria documented in internal runbook." Happy to edit.

olivia: Adding this thread to deploybot perma-log: `/logs/1767774321-synaptic-rollout` :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Deployment scheduled for 08:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/synaptic-rollout-1767774321. Good luck :rocket:

raj: Proceeding with the plan. Will DM the oncall links and metrics dashboards 30m before start. If anything looks off we abort and rollback immediately.

leah: Thanks team — I'll coordinate the manual pin lift. Catch up after phase2 for a quick decision call.

matt: If phase1 looks clean I'll open the global ramp PR and tag @product for final release note approval.

alex: Routing sanity check posted: `route: us-canary -> synaptic-13b (5%)` — all good.

deploybot: Deploybot: phase1 scheduled and in queue. Preflight reports preserved pinlist for EU.

raj: Solid. Thanks everyone.
